projects.name: NowNest
projects.intended: Make build 8 available for testing and evaluate the simplified core screen on a physical device.
projects.delivered: Tester availability confirmed. Unit, focused simulator UI and distribution checks passed. Physical-device validation remains open.
tests: 75 unit tests passed on an iPhone simulator
Focused iPhone and iPad UI checks passed
Archive, export and signature verification passed
limitations: Tester availability does not establish a public release
projects.rework: Core screen simplification and icon correction preceded build 8; rework duration and total count are unknown.
projects.hypothesis: A simpler core screen may improve comprehension; simulator checks cannot establish that outcome.
projects.action: Run a physical-device comprehension check, then validate tinted appearance, VoiceOver and real Apple Intelligence. Record dated results and limitations.

projects.name: Couch Clash
projects.intended: Deliver a usable shared game experience through public web and native TestFlight distribution.
projects.delivered: Web/manual-host prototype passed technical checks. Public web and native TestFlight deliveries remain in progress.
tests: Game flow, scoring, ties and locks passed
Mobile layout and keyboard checks passed
limitations: No user trial; enjoyment and comprehension remain unverified
Offline reload verified on localhost only; LAN HTTP offline reload unsupported
projects.rework: Clarified early calls as first-half only and exposed first-half outcomes and standings before halftime picks. Rework duration and total count are unknown.
projects.hypothesis: Clearer setup and visible results may reduce host explanation and make shared play easier; technical passes do not prove this.
projects.action: Complete delivery checks, then observe setup and comprehension in a small trial against a paper baseline. Separate observed behavior from participant feedback.

history.description: Recorded approved release status, technical checks and open validation gaps for both working-name projects. Unknown measurements remain null. No corrections recorded yet.
